era.founding.name: Founding
era.founding.desc: The first settlers clear the shore and raise their first huts.
terrain.plains.name: Plains
terrain.plains.desc: Open, level ground for houses, farms and most other buildings.
terrain.forest.name: Forest
terrain.forest.desc: Woodland that renews itself as it is cut.
terrain.hills.name: Hills
terrain.hills.desc: Rising ground where windmills catch the wind, too steep for fields.
terrain.beach.name: Beach
terrain.beach.desc: A sandy shore where boats are drawn up.
terrain.fen.name: Fen
terrain.fen.desc: Drained marsh: dark, rich soil that is firm enough to build on.
terrain.highlands.name: Highlands
terrain.highlands.desc: High moorland and ridges, out of reach until roads can climb them.
terrain.sea.name: Sea
terrain.sea.desc: Shallow coastal water, full of fish.
terrain.deep_water.name: Deep water
terrain.deep_water.desc: Dark open water beyond the shallows, out of reach until there are harbours.
terrain.reef.name: Reef
terrain.reef.desc: A ring of rock and coral that only careful divers can reach.
terrain.river.name: River
terrain.river.desc: Running water that roads cannot cross without a bridge.
terrain.marsh.name: Marsh
terrain.marsh.desc: Low, soggy ground that cannot be built on until it is drained.
terrain.peaks.name: Peaks
terrain.peaks.desc: Bare stone summits that nobody can build on.
good.wood.name: Wood
good.wood.desc: Logs cut from the forest, burned for warmth and sawn into timber.
good.timber.name: Timber
good.fish.name: Fish
good.wool.name: Wool
good.wool.desc: Fleece from the flock, ready for the loom.
good.homespun.name: Homespun
good.homespun.desc: Plain cloth woven from wool, for everyday wear.
good.grain.name: Grain
good.grain.desc: Ripe grain gathered from the fields.
good.flour.name: Flour
good.flour.desc: Grain ground fine and ready for the oven.
good.bread.name: Bread
recipe.cut_wood.name: Cut wood
recipe.saw_timber.name: Saw timber
recipe.catch_fish.name: Catch fish
recipe.shear_wool.name: Shear wool
recipe.weave_homespun.name: Weave homespun
recipe.weave_homespun.desc: Spin and weave wool into plain cloth.
recipe.grow_grain.name: Grow grain
recipe.grow_grain.desc: Sow, tend and reap a field of grain.
recipe.grind_flour.name: Grind flour
recipe.bake_bread.name: Bake bread
tier.settlers.name: Settlers
tier.settlers.desc: The first arrivals, who need fish, wood and a market.
tier.villagers.name: Villagers
tier.villagers.desc: Settled families who also need cloth and bread, keep a shrine, and add to the town's knowledge.
building.founders_hall.name: Founders' Hall
building.founders_hall.desc: The heart of the settlement: a storehouse, a market and a meeting place.
building.settler_house.name: Settler house
building.settler_house.desc: A simple home that grows with its residents.
building.dirt_road.name: Dirt road
building.dirt_road.desc: A beaten track that carts can follow.
building.storehouse.name: Storehouse
building.storehouse.desc: Keeps the settlement's goods and sends out carts.
building.market.name: Market
building.market.desc: A busy square where households fetch the goods they need.
building.woodcutters_hut.name: Woodcutter's hut
building.woodcutters_hut.desc: Woodcutters fell trees from the forest around it.
building.sawpit.name: Sawpit
building.fishing_hut.name: Fishing hut
building.fishing_hut.desc: Fishers net the shallows and bring home fish.
building.sheep_farm.name: Sheep farm
building.sheep_farm.desc: Shepherds keep a flock on open pasture and shear it for wool.
building.weavers_cottage.name: Weaver's cottage
building.weavers_cottage.desc: Weavers spin wool into plain homespun cloth.
building.grain_farm.name: Grain farm
building.grain_farm.desc: Broad fields of grain: the richer the soil, the better the harvest.
building.windmill.name: Windmill
building.windmill.desc: Grinds grain into flour; it works best on hills.
building.bakery.name: Bakery
building.shrine.name: Shrine
building.shrine.desc: A small, quiet place of rest and remembrance where neighbours gather.
tech.animal_husbandry.name: Animal Husbandry
tech.animal_husbandry.desc: Keeping a flock on open pasture brings wool to the settlement.
tech.cultivation.name: Cultivation
tech.cultivation.desc: Sowing and tending fields turns fertile ground into grain.
tech.weaving.name: Weaving
tech.weaving.desc: A loom turns wool into homespun cloth.
tech.milling.name: Milling
tech.milling.desc: Wind and stone grind grain into flour, and flour becomes bread.
tech.net_weaving.name: Net-weaving
tech.net_weaving.desc: Finer nets bring in more fish.
civic.hearth_and_shrine.name: Hearth & Shrine
civic.hearth_and_shrine.desc: A shared hearth and a quiet shrine give the village its first common ground.
